domains.name: Creative Intelligence
domains.description: Product-grounded creative direction, visual storytelling, originality, and contextual anti-generic judgment.

domains.name: Visual Design Intelligence
domains.description: Typography, color theory, hierarchy, composition, grids, spacing, materiality, and visual density.

domains.name: UX Intelligence
domains.description: Information architecture, cognitive load, navigation, forms, resilient states, and mobile usability.

domains.name: Design System Intelligence
domains.description: Design tokens, semantic scales, light/dark theming, and persistent cross-session design continuity.

domains.name: Component Intelligence
domains.description: Existing component discovery, reuse-first composition, accessible primitives, and state boundaries.

domains.name: Motion Intelligence
domains.description: Purposeful transitions, spring/easing curves, choreography, performance, and reduced-motion compliance.

domains.name: Frontend Engineering Intelligence
domains.description: Semantic HTML, modern CSS, TypeScript/framework implementation, rendering performance, and security.

domains.name: Specialized Product Intelligence
domains.description: Domain-specific adaptation for SaaS, fintech, e-commerce, AI workspaces, portfolios, and mobile apps.

domains.name: Verification Intelligence
domains.description: Rendered visual critique, responsive checks, accessibility auditing, functional testing, and bounded refinement.

domains.name: Optimization Intelligence
domains.description: Code economy, context economy, progressive loading, tool-call minimization, and architectural restraint.

capabilities.name: Product-Grounded Creative Brief
capabilities.purpose: Anchor every visual and structural decision in the product's actual subject matter, audience, and primary job.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Synthesize a concise brief covering subject, audience, primary user action, emotional tone, and one focal point before writing UI code.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents decorative templates by deriving aesthetics from real domain constraints.
conflicts: May conflict with existing design systems; Priority 5 wins unless redesign is requested.
acceptance_criteria: Brief states audience, primary job, and focal element in under 120 words.
Visual choices trace back to brief.

capabilities.name: Contextual Anti-Generic Judgment
capabilities.purpose: Detect and replace repetitive, clichéd AI UI patterns without imposing rigid universal aesthetic bans.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Audit planned layouts, typography, copy, badges, and decoration against the brief; keep common patterns only when they genuinely serve the product.
capabilities.unique_value: Replaces brittle ban-lists with product-aware design reasoning.
conflicts: Explicit user aesthetic requests override anti-generic heuristics (Priority 2 > 6).
acceptance_criteria: No unmotivated decorative badges, filler stats, or cloned card grids.
Explicit user style requests preserved.

capabilities.name: Focal Restraint & Hero Composition
capabilities.purpose: Concentrate visual boldness in one memorable focal element while keeping surrounding chrome disciplined.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Select the most characteristic opening treatment (live demo, editorial headline, interactive visual, or product artifact) and trim competing accents.
capabilities.unique_value: Eliminates visual noise and competing focal points above the fold.
conflicts: Can clash with dense SaaS/dashboard entry views; adapt via FF-SP-01.
acceptance_criteria: Clear primary focal point above the fold.
Supporting elements remain visually subordinate.

capabilities.name: Multi-Direction Concept Exploration
capabilities.purpose: Explore distinct creative directions before committing on high-stakes flagship interfaces.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Draft 2-3 genuinely distinct visual/structural concepts in compact prose and select the strongest fit against the brief.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents anchoring on the first mediocre layout idea.
conflicts: Increases initial reasoning tokens; restricted to FLAGSHIP or explicit request (FF-OP-02).
acceptance_criteria: Concepts differ in layout structure and visual voice, not just color swap.
Selection rationale documented concisely.

capabilities.name: Unified Typography Engine
capabilities.purpose: Combine expressive font selection, pairing, hierarchy, fluid scaling, readability, accessibility, and webfont performance.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Select 1-2 intentional typefaces, set a disciplined responsive scale (clamp/fluid steps), cap body measure under 75-80ch, and optimize font loading.
capabilities.unique_value: Unifies expressive type craft with readability and Core Web Vitals.
conflicts: Expressive display fonts vs. bundle/CLS budget; resolved by subsetting and font-display swap.
acceptance_criteria: Clear size/weight hierarchy.
Readable line length and line-height.
No layout shift from font loading.

capabilities.name: Semantic & Accessible Color Architecture
capabilities.purpose: Pair color psychology and palette harmony with WCAG contrast compliance and semantic surface/ink roles.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Define a compact 4-6 color base mapped to semantic roles (bg, surface, text, muted, accent, status) with verified contrast ratios.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents arbitrary hex sprawl and low-contrast text.
conflicts: Brand accent colors vs. WCAG AA/AAA contrast; Priority 4 enforces accessible text/UI contrast.
acceptance_criteria: Text contrast >= 4.5:1 (3:1 large text/UI).
Semantic roles used consistently across components.

capabilities.name: Layout Grid, Alignment & Optical Balance
capabilities.purpose: Structure pages using intentional grids, responsive breakpoints, optical alignment, and disciplined whitespace.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use CSS Grid/Flexbox with consistent spacing rhythm, deliberate alignment (left/asymmetric/centered by role), and zero horizontal overflow.
capabilities.unique_value: Eliminates misaligned elements, cramped cards, and broken mobile grids.
conflicts: Asymmetric editorial layouts vs. mobile stacking; mobile readability wins (Priority 4).
acceptance_criteria: Zero horizontal scroll from 320px to 1440px+.
Consistent spacing scale and optical alignment.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Visual Density & Materiality
capabilities.purpose: Calibrate whitespace, elevation, borders, and information density to the product type.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Apply higher information density for operational dashboards and generous breathing room for editorial/marketing surfaces.
capabilities.unique_value: Stops SaaS tools from feeling empty and marketing pages from feeling cluttered.
conflicts: High data density vs. touch target minimums; touch targets >= 44px on touch viewports.
acceptance_criteria: Density matches user task frequency.
Elevation/borders clarify grouping without visual noise.

capabilities.name: Iconography & Media Art Direction
capabilities.purpose: Ensure icons, illustrations, and imagery carry real informational or atmospheric value with consistent style.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use a single consistent icon stroke/weight, pair icons with clear labels where needed, and enforce aspect-ratio/alt-text discipline on media.
capabilities.unique_value: Removes meaningless decorative icons and mismatched visual assets.
conflicts: Icon-only buttons vs. discoverability; require accessible names and clear affordance.
acceptance_criteria: Consistent icon family/stroke.
All meaningful media has accurate alt text and explicit dimensions.

capabilities.name: Information Architecture & Task Navigation
capabilities.purpose: Organize navigation and page hierarchy around user tasks and mental models rather than internal system structure.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Group navigation by user goals, maintain clear active/breadcrumb signposting, and limit top-level cognitive load.
capabilities.unique_value: Improves findability and reduces user disorientation.
conflicts: Minimalist nav hiding vs. discoverability; primary tasks remain directly reachable.
acceptance_criteria: Primary actions discoverable without guessing.
Consistent terminology across triggers and destinations.

capabilities.name: Interface Microcopy & Action Clarity
capabilities.purpose: Make labels, CTAs, headings, and helper text specific, active, user-centric, and jargon-free.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use active outcome verbs on buttons, match action-to-confirmation vocabulary, and replace generic marketing filler with concrete product facts.
capabilities.unique_value: Turns copy into functional navigation rather than decorative noise.
conflicts: Brand voice playfulness vs. clarity; clarity wins on transactional/error copy (Priority 4).
acceptance_criteria: CTAs state exact outcome.
No fake statistics or generic placeholder slogans.

capabilities.name: Resilient UI States & Error Recovery
capabilities.purpose: Design explicit loading, empty, error, partial, and success states for every interactive flow.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Provide non-blocking loading feedback, actionable empty states, specific non-blaming error recovery, and clear confirmation.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents dead-end screens and silent failures in real usage.
conflicts: Quick-mode minimal edits vs. state coverage; async flows always require error/loading handling (Priority 3).
acceptance_criteria: All async states handled.
Error states explain what happened and how to recover.

capabilities.name: Form Usability & Mobile Ergonomics
capabilities.purpose: Optimize forms, validation, progressive disclosure, and touch ergonomics across desktop and mobile.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use visible labels, logical field grouping, inline non-punitive validation, appropriate input types/autocomplete, and >=44px touch targets.
capabilities.unique_value: Directly improves conversion, accessibility, and mobile completion rates.
conflicts: Compact single-line forms vs. clear labels/errors; visible labels and readable errors win (Priority 4).
acceptance_criteria: Every input has a programmatic label.
Touch targets and mobile keyboard types are appropriate.

capabilities.name: Tokenized Design System Architecture
capabilities.purpose: Establish compact, semantic design tokens for color, typography, spacing, radii, and elevation.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Define CSS custom properties or project-native tokens separating primitive values from semantic roles.
capabilities.unique_value: Enables consistent theming and low-cost maintenance across pages.
conflicts: Over-engineered token hierarchies vs. code economy; keep token count minimal and semantic (FF-OP-01).
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded magic colors/spacing when tokens exist.
Tokens map cleanly to semantic roles.

capabilities.name: Light & Dark Theme Parity
capabilities.purpose: Support coherent light and dark modes with proper surface elevation and contrast.
activation_conditions: when dual-theme or dark mode is requested or supported by project
capabilities.unified_behavior: Swap semantic tokens across themes, invert elevation cues cleanly (lighter surfaces for higher elevation in dark mode), and re-verify contrast.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents broken contrast or muddy grays in dark mode.
conflicts: Single-theme brand briefs vs. dual-mode overhead; only build dual themes when requested or project-standard.
acceptance_criteria: Contrast >= 4.5:1 in all supported modes.
No un-themed hardcoded colors.

capabilities.name: Persistent Project Design Memory
capabilities.purpose: Record compact project design decisions so future sessions preserve visual and structural continuity.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Read existing project design docs/tokens first; when establishing a new system, store a compact, human-readable token and convention summary.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents style drift across incremental feature additions.
conflicts: Extra doc file vs. minimal file footprint; store only when multi-page/multi-session continuity is needed.
acceptance_criteria: New pages inherit established tokens, typography, and component patterns.

capabilities.name: Existing Component Discovery & Reuse
capabilities.purpose: Discover and reuse existing project components before writing new UI primitives.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Search project component directories and design system exports first; extend or compose existing primitives instead of duplicating them.
capabilities.unique_value: Maximizes consistency and eliminates redundant component code.
conflicts: Creative experimentation vs. existing component library; Priority 5 preserves existing components.
acceptance_criteria: Zero duplicate Button/Modal/Input/Card implementations when suitable ones exist.

capabilities.name: Accessible Interactive Primitives
capabilities.purpose: Ensure dialogs, menus, tabs, tooltips, and custom controls implement full keyboard, focus, and ARIA semantics.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Prefer native HTML elements (<button>, <dialog>, <details>) or established accessible primitives; enforce focus trap, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
capabilities.unique_value: Eliminates keyboard traps and screen-reader blind spots.
conflicts: Custom visual styling vs. native semantics; never replace native semantics with clickable <div>s.
acceptance_criteria: 100% keyboard operable.
Visible focus ring.
Accurate ARIA roles and states.

capabilities.name: Minimal Component Composition & State Boundaries
capabilities.purpose: Keep component APIs small, composable, and free of speculative props or wrapper bloat.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Keep state as local as possible, derive computed values directly without effects, and split components only when complexity or reuse demands it.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents over-abstracted prop-drilling and fragile wrapper layers.
conflicts: Future-proofing urge vs. code economy; YAGNI wins (Priority 8).
acceptance_criteria: No unused props or speculative variants.
No redundant state or effect-synchronized derived values.

capabilities.name: Purposeful Motion Hierarchy & Curves
capabilities.purpose: Ensure every animation serves orientation, feedback, or focal hierarchy with calibrated timing and easing.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use crisp, short durations (120-300ms for micro-interactions), natural deceleration curves, and at most one orchestrated page-load moment.
capabilities.unique_value: Replaces sluggish, scattered AI fade-ins with tactile, intentional motion.
conflicts: Motion richness vs. page speed/calmness; restraint wins.
acceptance_criteria: Every animation has a stated UX or focal purpose.
No scattered entrance animations on every card.

capabilities.name: GPU-Composited & Interruptible Transitions
capabilities.purpose: Keep animations smooth at 60fps+ and responsive to mid-flight user interruption.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Animate transform and opacity rather than layout properties; prefer CSS transitions/WAAPI for simple states and interruptible springs for gestures.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents layout thrashing and janky locked transitions.
conflicts: Animation library convenience vs. bundle size; CSS/native first (FF-OP-01).
acceptance_criteria: No layout-property animation (width/height/top/left) where transform suffices.
Rapid toggling does not break state.

capabilities.name: Reduced-Motion Accessibility Compliance
capabilities.purpose: Respect user prefers-reduced-motion settings across all CSS and JS animations.
activation_conditions: any task introducing motion or transitions
capabilities.unified_behavior: Wrap non-essential motion in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference or provide instant/opacity-only fallbacks under reduce.
capabilities.unique_value: Protects vestibular-sensitive users as a mandatory quality gate.
conflicts: Creative motion showcases vs. user health; Priority 4 always wins.
acceptance_criteria: All non-essential motion disabled or softened under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

capabilities.name: Semantic HTML & Modern CSS Architecture
capabilities.purpose: Build clean, maintainable markup and low-specificity CSS using native platform features.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Use landmark elements, heading hierarchy, CSS Grid/Flexbox, custom properties, :has(), and clamp(); avoid selector specificity collisions.
capabilities.unique_value: Reduces JS weight and improves baseline accessibility and resilience.
conflicts: Framework utility classes vs. custom CSS; follow existing project conventions (Priority 5).
acceptance_criteria: Valid landmark/heading order.
Zero CSS specificity wars or !important hacks.

capabilities.name: Stack-Respecting Framework Implementation
capabilities.purpose: Detect and follow the repository's existing framework, TypeScript config, styling system, and patterns.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Inspect package.json and tsconfig before coding; write idiomatic React/Next/Vue/Svelte/vanilla code without unrequested migrations.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents destructive rewrites and dependency bloat.
conflicts: Preferred framework idioms vs. legacy repo patterns; preserve repo conventions (Priority 5).
acceptance_criteria: Typechecks and builds cleanly with existing project toolchain.
Zero unapproved stack migrations.

capabilities.name: Frontend Performance & Bundle Discipline
capabilities.purpose: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), asset delivery, and JavaScript bundle size.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Lazy-load offscreen/heavy modules, reserve media dimensions to prevent CLS, minimize client JS hydration, and avoid heavy runtime dependencies.
capabilities.unique_value: Keeps interfaces fast on real-world devices and networks.
conflicts: Rich interactive widgets vs. bundle weight; code-split non-critical interactivity.
acceptance_criteria: Zero unoptimized large assets.
No avoidable layout shifts or main-thread blocking.

capabilities.name: Client-Side Security & Safe Rendering
capabilities.purpose: Prevent XSS, unsafe HTML injection, open redirects, and secret exposure in frontend code.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Sanitize or avoid raw HTML injection, validate external URLs, enforce safe target=_blank rel attributes, and never expose private keys.
capabilities.unique_value: Enforces security as a non-negotiable delivery gate.
conflicts: None; Priority 1 overrides all other concerns.
acceptance_criteria: Zero unsanitized HTML injection.
No secrets or unsafe link targets.

capabilities.name: Product-Domain Pattern Adaptation
capabilities.purpose: Tailor density, trust signals, navigation, and typography to the specific product category.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Apply domain-appropriate ergonomics: scannable KPIs/tables for SaaS & fintech, clarity/trust for healthcare/e-commerce, expressive pacing for portfolios.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents one-size-fits-all aesthetics across incompatible industries.
conflicts: Minimalist aesthetics vs. regulatory/trust disclosures; trust and clarity win (Priority 4).
acceptance_criteria: Layout density and trust cues match target product category.

capabilities.name: AI-Native Interface Ergonomics
capabilities.purpose: Design clear, trustworthy interfaces for streaming, provenance, citations, human-in-the-loop review, and prompt workflows.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Provide responsive streaming states, cancel/retry controls, clear distinction between AI output and verified facts, and non-intrusive context controls.
capabilities.unique_value: Addresses UX failure modes unique to probabilistic AI products.
conflicts: Flashy AI sparkle tropes vs. clarity; prioritize control and legibility over gimmicks.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming, stop, error, and provenance states are clear and keyboard-accessible.

capabilities.name: Mobile-First & Touch Viewport Craft
capabilities.purpose: Engineer interfaces for small viewports, thumb reachability, safe areas, and touch gestures.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Design primary flows at 375px first, respect safe-area insets and dynamic viewport units (dvh), and avoid hover-only interactions.
capabilities.unique_value: Ensures mobile is a first-class experience rather than a squished desktop page.
conflicts: Hover-revealed desktop actions vs. touch; provide explicit visible triggers on touch.
acceptance_criteria: Zero hover-locked functionality.
Clean ergonomics at 320px-430px viewports.

capabilities.name: Rendered Visual & Responsive Inspection
capabilities.purpose: Verify actual rendered output across desktop and mobile viewports before claiming visual quality.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Render the live app/page, inspect desktop and mobile viewports for overflow, clipping, contrast, alignment, and hierarchy, and capture evidence.
capabilities.unique_value: Catches real layout and rendering bugs invisible in source code.
conflicts: Verification thoroughness vs. tool-call economy; scale viewport checks to mode risk.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered output inspected before claiming visual verification.
No clipping, overlap, or unintended overflow.

capabilities.name: Accessibility & Keyboard Gate Audit
capabilities.purpose: Verify keyboard navigation, focus visibility, semantics, contrast, and reduced motion as a mandatory release gate.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Check tab order, Escape/Enter/Space behavior, contrast ratios, form labels, landmarks, and reduced-motion behavior.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents inaccessible interfaces from passing evaluation.
conflicts: None; mandatory gate (Priority 4).
acceptance_criteria: All interactive controls keyboard-reachable.
Zero critical a11y gate failures.

capabilities.name: Functional & Regression Verification
capabilities.purpose: Verify build, typecheck, unit/integration tests, and interactive flows after final edits.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Run the project's relevant build/test commands or targeted functional checks after the last edit and report exact observed outcomes.
capabilities.unique_value: Ensures code actually compiles and works as intended.
conflicts: None; mandatory gate (Priority 3).
acceptance_criteria: Build/typecheck passes.
Targeted tests/interactions verified after final edit.

capabilities.name: Bounded Evidence-Driven Refinement
capabilities.purpose: Run targeted critique-and-fix loops that stop as soon as acceptance criteria are met.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Log specific defects from rendered inspection, fix root causes, re-verify only affected areas, and halt when criteria pass or gains plateau.
capabilities.unique_value: Prevents infinite polish loops and wasteful token burn.
conflicts: Perfectionism vs. bounded iteration; explicit stopping conditions win.
acceptance_criteria: Each refinement pass addresses a documented defect.
Loop terminates within mode bound.

capabilities.name: Code & Dependency Economy Engine
capabilities.purpose: Minimize code volume, abstractions, and dependencies without sacrificing readability or quality.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Apply the 6-step code decision ladder before creating files, wrappers, state, or installing packages; delete dead code before finishing.
capabilities.unique_value: Keeps generated frontends lean, readable, and dependency-light.
conflicts: Premature DRY/abstraction vs. readability; prefer clear local code over speculative abstractions.
acceptance_criteria: Zero unrequested dependencies.
Zero dead code or redundant wrappers.

capabilities.name: Progressive Context & Token Routing
capabilities.purpose: Keep startup and per-task context overhead minimal via leveled disclosure and targeted file reads.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Keep SKILL.md concise (Level 1), load only task-matched references (Level 2/3), and inspect repo structure/symbols before reading files.
capabilities.unique_value: Reduces input/output token waste across both simple and complex tasks.
conflicts: Comprehensive reference guides vs. context budget; split into focused Level 2 modules.
acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md <= 250 lines.
Only task-relevant modules loaded per run.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Mode & Risk-Based Verification Scaling
capabilities.purpose: Match workflow depth and verification cost to actual task risk and complexity.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Select QUICK/STANDARD/PREMIUM/FLAGSHIP automatically, allowing user override, and scale verification checks proportionally.
capabilities.unique_value: Avoids heavy design ceremonies on 5-line fixes while protecting flagship quality.
conflicts: User override vs. auto-classification; user override wins (Priority 2).
acceptance_criteria: Trivial edits run in QUICK mode.
Complex greenfield UIs escalate to PREMIUM/FLAGSHIP.

capabilities.name: Universal Aesthetic Ban-Lists
capabilities.purpose: Evaluated rigid blanket bans on gradients, cards, rounded corners, shadows, or centered heroes.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Replaced by FF-CR-02 contextual anti-generic judgment.
capabilities.unique_value: None; rigid bans break legitimate product briefs.
conflicts: Directly contradicts user authority and product-specific design.
acceptance_criteria: Not implemented in FORMFORGE.

capabilities.name: Static Preset Theme Gallery
capabilities.purpose: Evaluated bundling fixed named color/font theme presets as default styling.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Replaced by product-grounded palette and typography synthesis (FF-CR-01, FF-VD-01, FF-VD-02).
capabilities.unique_value: None; preset galleries encourage generic template reuse.
conflicts: Encourages arbitrary theme picking over domain grounding.
acceptance_criteria: No static preset theme gallery bundled.

capabilities.name: Speculative Custom CLI & Knowledge Graph Runtime
capabilities.purpose: Evaluated building a custom Node/Python CLI, database, or knowledge-graph engine in Phase 01.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Replaced by portable file-based Progressive Context Architecture (FF-OP-02).
capabilities.unique_value: None; violates architectural economy and portability.
conflicts: Adds maintenance and dependency overhead without proven need.
acceptance_criteria: Zero speculative runtime infrastructure in Phase 01.

capabilities.name: Automated Multi-Model Visual Judge & Motion Telemetry
capabilities.purpose: Automated headless browser screenshot scoring, frame-drop telemetry, and blind A/B judge pipeline.
capabilities.unified_behavior: Deferred until Phase 02 capability modules and Phase 03 baseline eval runs establish concrete measurement targets.
capabilities.unique_value: Will provide reproducible quantitative quality and motion telemetry once baseline exists.
conflicts: Premature automation before Level 2 modules are authored.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled for Phase 04 after baseline manual/semi-automated evals.
